status: pre-registered before any perturbed inlet was computed and before any solver run of this step
question: Hand-error robustness (part of the user's acceptance rule for step 1 'the physical model works'): does the pourable S1 design still form the six patterns when the hand is imperfect?

design.pitcher: nx (CAD NX, b 4.86 mm), wall resolved, cup held (no table)
design.per_pattern: fill, per-stroke wanted heights z_k, yaw, roll, s (all 1) from final.json 'design'; no 5 Hz pulse; spout lag 0.08 s, ramps 0.1 s, bridges >= 0.3 s, ztr transitions (drvf rules)

driver.code: /home/user/zfChen/latte_imex/v05_pourable.py, section ROBUST (rb_program / rb_solve), built on the unchanged PourF + pitcher_tables + plan_lift of the DESIGN section; solver latte_imex.run.run (unchanged), control 'v05', N = 256, the surrogate inlet (lat/ulaw 'pitcher')
driver.identity_check:
the unperturbed rb_program must reproduce the Solve step's S1 runs: replaying the t column of design/runs/S1_

_N256/inlet_log.npy through it gives the same rows (all columns but ncall%2); plus one full 256^2 run (push_heart) compared bit for bit (c field, deposit)

perturbations.common: each perturbation is applied to every flowing stroke (classes low and cut) of the pattern; the path (foot x, y and its timing), yaw and roll are never changed

P2.what: delivered spout height -3 mm, never below the pitcher's clearance z_min (clip; the clipped amount is recorded per stroke)

P5.what: flow schedule 50 ms late relative to the path

P6.what: flow schedule 50 ms early relative to the path

R.generator: numpy.random.default_rng(seed); loop draw R1..R3, pattern (order above), stroke (phase order); per stroke uniform(-3, 3) mm, uniform(0.8, 1.2), uniform(-50, 50) ms

implementation.height: the hand's error is on the DELIVERED tip height: z(t) = z_w(t) + L_nom(t) + dz(t) + L_x(t), z_w = the design's wanted height with drvf's ztr transitions, L_nom = the design's planned clearance lift (nominal flow), dz(t) = the per-stroke offset, L_x = plan_lift(max(z_min'(t) - (z_w + L_nom + dz), 0)) (the same lift rule as the design: 0.25 s running max, hand closing, +0.2 mm; 0 in 'stop' phases) with z_min' the clearance of the PERTURBED pitcher state.  'clipped' = L_x (flow-weighted mean and max per stroke).  dz(t) is constant inside a stroke, linear across a bridge/stop between two flowing strokes, held before the first / after the last flowing stroke, and at a boundary between two adjacent flowing strokes a linear ramp centred on the boundary with drvf's ztr half-width 0.5 max(|d dz| / 0.11 m/s, 0.05 s)
implementation.flow: factor f_k on the command envelope of stroke k BEFORE the 0.08 s spout lag (PourF's s_scale; the design has s = 1); delivered Q clipped to 1-32 mL/s by drvf's rule
implementation.timing: the command envelope (incl. f_k) is time-warped, E'(t) = E(t - delta(t)), then passed through the same 0.08 s first-order lag; delta(t) = delta_k inside stroke k, linear across bridges/stops, held outside, a linear ramp of half-width 0.08 s centred on a boundary between two adjacent flowing strokes (warp stays monotone); flow pushed before t = 0 or after the end is lost
implementation.pitcher_state: the pitcher tables (fill V(t) = fill - poured, tilt, exit speed u0, exit vector, jet origin, clearance z_min) are recomputed from the PERTURBED delivered flow; V is clamped at the surrogate floor 20 mL (the unclamped minimum is recorded: below ~20 mL the pitcher would run dry)
implementation.records: per run and stroke from the 1 ms inlet (inlet_strokes): chi, z, Q, U_perp, |u_h|, V, tilt, lift; P2/R clipping; V_end unclamped; written to robust/inlet.json

judge.how: V05_ALLPHYS_RESULT section 3.1 criteria with v05allphys/final/ana.py (unchanged, via a path patch) plus looking at the images, the same way the Solve step judged the nominal S1 runs (verdict yes / partial / no); swan additionally with the Solve step's swanconn.py (head-body bottleneck, head blob) and neck2.py

criteria.heart: yes: heart outline + tip (the brown axis seam is noted, not a criterion); partial: outline but tip missing / lobes merged; no: no heart
criteria.push_heart: yes: the arms are separated (seam counts on y = -0.1/0/+0.1 D as reference, nominal 3/7/5); partial: arms partly merged; no: merged
criteria.layered_heart: yes: closed outline AND >= 4 bright bands on BOTH x = -0.05 and x = +0.05 D (structm) AND curl c95 >= 0.7 on both sides; partial: closed outline but a band count < 4 or a curl < 0.7; no: open outline / no layering (nominal S1: 5/4, 0.86/0.85)
criteria.tulip: yes: closed outline, three stacked petals, >= 2 inter-petal seams at x = -0.06 and +0.06 D (structm off_dark; nominal 4/3); partial: two layers or < 2 seams on one side; no: no petals
criteria.leaf: yes: mean >= 5 veins per profile and mean amplitude >= ~0.15 (nominal 5.75, 0.34); partial: 4-5 veins or amplitude 0.10-0.15; no: fewer
criteria.swan: yes: neck continuous (eye; reference = head-body bottleneck t* of swanconn.py >= 0.5, nominal 0.635; structm's ridge minimum is only a reference, it can jump), head present (connected head blob c > 0.6 >= 5 mm^2, nominal 24), wing lines; partial: neck faint/broken in one section (t* < 0.5) or head missing; no: neck broken AND no head

judge.rule: per pattern PASS iff P1-P6 are all 'yes' except at most one 'partial' (any 'no' fails) AND at least 2 of R1-R3 are 'yes'

budget: 54 runs at 256^2, at most 2 solver processes (NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=1), the PitcherLoop step may run at the same time

outputs.grid: robust/robust_grid.png (rows six patterns, columns nominal + P1-P6 + R1-R3, colours/crops of FS_six)
